description: This file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveService class, which provides a service layer for managing employees on leave within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin. It encapsulates an EmployeeOnLeaveDao dependency and exposes a method to access it, as well as a constant configuration key.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveService
classes.description: Service class managing operations related to employees on leave, providing access to the EmployeeOnLeaveDao component and configuration constants.

methods.name: getEmployeeOnLeaveDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of EmployeeOnLeaveDao, initializing it if necessary.
